articles.summary: KANSAS CITY, Mo. (Jan. 1, 2026) &mdash; Commerce Bancshares, Inc. (NASDAQ: CBSH) (“Commerce”), the parent company of Commerce Bank, announced today the closing of its previously announced acquisition of FineMark Holdings, Inc., the parent company of FineMark National Bank & Trust.
articles.title: Commerce Bancshares, Inc. completes FineMark Holdings, Inc. acquisition
